service.description: Deliver DataFeedPending rows: assemble each document and call the receive service (or, for a document that no longer assembles, the delete service) of every real-time push DataFeed that has it, then remove the rows that were delivered. A commit runs this for its own rows on a service worker. With no IDs a batch of every pending row is tried, for rows a failed or full worker left behind. A row whose delivery still fails after stuckMinutes pending is an error of the batch, so the job run is kept and its error handling fires; the rows stay pending.

parameter.name: stuckMinutes
parameter.description: With no IDs, how long a row may keep failing before the batch is an error.
